text:
Nora (CS): Opening a follow-up thread after the inference latency outage. We need: 1) a short public status update, 2) a private customer note for affected enterprise accounts (SLA impact + mitigation plan), 3) an internal RCA timeline and redaction flow. Can we assign owners?

Ben (SRE): I'll take remediation ownership. Immediate plan: emergency config rollback now, then a durable fix implementing adaptive rate limits and better autoscale tests. Hotfix ETA: 48 hours. Durable fix ETA: 10 business days.

Carlos (PM): We observed this pattern twice in last 6 months. I want a recurring-incident section in the PM postmortem and a cross-team action to add a regression test to CI. I'll run the retro and own the list of follow-ups.

Ops-bot: Created issue RED-5512 and attached initial logs. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RED-5512

Mei (Comms): Draft public status line (aim for <= 280 chars):
"09:05–09:30 UTC - Elevated API latency caused some requests to time out or be slower. A mitigation is in place and we're monitoring. A short incident summary will be posted within 24 hours; a full RCA within 7 business days. For enterprise impact please contact your account team."

Nora (CS): For enterprise customers we need a private template that includes: affected zones, duration, SLA impact (downtime/latency metrics), mitigation steps taken, and next steps + ETA for full fix. Suggest Sales+CS prep this so AEs can respond immediately.

Ben (SRE): Agree on template. I'll provide the technical appendix for private notes (redacted logs + timeline). Security must sign off on any raw logs/diagrams before sharing.

Security Team: Confirmed. Any RCA attachments with IPs, hostnames, or raw logs require redaction and Security approval. Add step in tracker: security/redaction review.

Carlos (PM): I'm adding these follow-ups to RED-5512 with owners and due dates. Proposed action list:
- Ben: hotfix rollback  due 2026-05-03
- Ben: durable fix + tests  due 2026-05-17
- Carlos: retro + recurring-incident doc  due 2026-05-06
- Mei: publish short status update (24h)  due 2026-05-02
- Nora + Sales: enterprise private note template  due 2026-05-02
- Security: RCA redaction sign-off step  due 2026-05-05

Mei (Comms): Suggested public cadence: initial short status (24h), interim update with mitigation details (48-72h), final summary + link to RCA (7 business days). Keep public messaging high level; use private channel for affected enterprise details.

Nora (CS): I'll compile the list of affected accounts and add to RED-5512. Sales/AEs: please flag any customers who request immediate engagement.

Ben (SRE): Also adding monitoring changes: new dashboard panels for queue depth and a critical alert if 90th percentile queue grows > X for 5m. ETA for dashboards: 5 days.

Carlos (PM): Scheduling retro on Friday 16:00 PST. Invite SRE, infra-test, CS, Comms, Security, Sales.

Mei (Comms): I'll post the short status update on the status page now and ping #status-updates when live. Draft sent to this thread for quick review:
"We experienced elevated latency between 09:05 and 09:30 UTC affecting some API requests. A mitigation has been applied and monitoring is ongoing. We will publish a full incident summary and RCA within 7 business days. If you are an enterprise customer with concerns, please contact your account team."

Nora (CS): LGTM. Minor edit: add support@redwood.ai for direct outreach.

Mei (Comms): Updated and posted. Channel note sent. :white_check_mark:

Ops-bot: RED-5512 updated: owners assigned (Ben, Carlos, Mei, Nora), due dates set.

Carlos (PM): Thanks everyone. We'll track progress in RED-5512; please update tickets as work completes. I'll close the loop in this thread after the retro with final owners and SLA communication plan.
